title: Great app, great people behind the app too!
body: I’ve been trying different habit trackers since 2018 and HelloHabit is the only one that stuck. I’ve had this for more than a year now and I’ve been consistent with it. It’s very easy to use, the interface is simple but pretty, everything is straightforward. It has everything you need in a habit tracker without being too complicated. Really helps with my ADHD. My favorite thing about HelloHabit though is the people behind it. Support is very helpful, they respond as soon as they can AND they actually listen to feedback - even going the extra mile, crowdsourcing feature ideas from the community(!!!). One of my favorite purchases ever :)
author: amoeba2000

title: Shows promise
body:
TLDR: It’s like finding a promising indie game on Steam or itchio. It doesn’t have a generic, cookie-cutter design too.

The onboarding and habit creation are straight to the point. The UX is what I expect from a small independent organization — the biggest positive is its direct-ness. The UI still needs refinement (not to be confused with buggy, it’s stable). Do not be discouraged by how it looks.

At its current price point, there’s not much to consider. It’s priced the same as (or lower than) most subscription-based habit trackers.

If this is result of the current direction of the product, then its development should be worth following.
author: Nogurenn
